childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Abalongo bwe bazaalibwa okulaba kwabwe kuba kubi. Mu bukulu ‘bazibe’. Wabula okulaba kwabwe kujja kukulaakulana mu myaka 5 ku 8 egiddako ng’okulongoosa okusinga kubaawo mu myezi 18 egisooka egy’obulamu. Kino kiseera kizibu nnyo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: Mu kiseera kino enkola y’okulaba kw’amaaso n’obwongo yeetaaga okuba ennungi era ng’esikirizibwa. Kino kye kiseera ekisinga obulungi okuzuula obulwadde n’okusindika okujjanjabibwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Lwaki n’engeri gye tuzuulamu endwadde okusobola okutumbula enkula y’okulaba
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Obulwadde bwonna obw’eriiso oba obwongo bujja kukendeeza ku nkula n’okukomya okulaba okumala ebbanga eddene. Eno y’ensonga lwaki kikulu okuzuula amangu nga bwe kisoboka ebivaako obulwadde bwonna obuyinza okujjanjabibwa obukosa enkula eya bulijjo ey’okulaba n’okukula okwa bulijjo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Kino osobola okukikola nga obuuza ebibuuzo ebikwata ku kulaba, embuto, okuzaala, endwadde zonna n’enkula yonna
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: olwo weetegereza amaaso nga weetegereza enkula y’amaaso olwo okwekebejja obulwadde bw’amaaso ng’okola okukebera kwa fundal ‘red’ reflex test n’okukebera emmanju w’eriiso
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: Munda mu lubuto, omwana ali mu lubuto yeetooloddwa amaloboozi amagonvu era agakkakkanya omuli n’okukuba kw’omutima gwa nnyina n’amaloboozi n’amaloboozi okuva mu nsi ebweru.
Olubuto bwe lutuuka ku mitendera gyalwo egy’enkomerero, amaaso g’omwana gasobola okugguka munda mu lubuto.
Wadde nga tebannaba kulaba bifaananyi oba ebikwata ku nsonga eno, basobola okuwulira enkyukakyuka mu kitangaala.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Ekyokulabirako ky’omutendera gw’olubuto eky’omwana ali mu lubuto mu lubuto
Ekyokulabirako ky’omutendera gw’olubuto olusembayo nga kiraga okutegeera ekitangaala
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: Ku kuzaalibwa okulaba kwawukana nnyo n’okw’omuntu omukulu. Omwana omuwere aba ‘muzibe’ nga obukali bw’okulaba embi ya 6/600. Tezitegeera langi nnyingi era zirina enjawulo entono. Tebalina stereovision era amaaso gaabwe gayinza okuzimba kati n’emirundi.

Wabula bajja kutunuulira butereevu ffeesi eziri okumpi ennyo, era banyige amaaso gaabwe nga gazibye amataala agayakaayakana. Okwolesebwa kwabwe okuva kati kugenda kukula mangu nnyo era kufuuke ng’omuntu omukulu ku myaka 8 egy’obukulu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: Mu wiiki bbiri okulaba kulongooseddwa nnyo. Kati basobola okulaba ebimu ku bintu naddala ng’ebintu biba kumpi. Tewali langi era bye balaba biba bipapajjo, kubanga amaaso gaabwe tegannaba bulijjo nga gagoloddwa era nga gakolagana okusobola okutegeera obuziba.
Oluusi amaaso gaabwe gajja kukulukuta okuyingira oba okufuluma okumala akaseera katono. Kino kiyitibwa okuzimba amaaso. Kino kisaana okulekera awo okubaawo nga wayise emyezi esatu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: We gunaatuukira omwezi gumu okulaba langi kutandise okukula. Bajja kuba bafaayo nnyo okulaba naddala ku maaso. Era bajja kutandika okugezaako okugoberera ebintu ebitambula.
Bajja kweyongera okumanya amaloboozi agamanyiddwa omuli n’amaloboozi agamanyiddwa ennyo ng’ab’omu maka gaabwe. Era tandika okugatta bye bawulira n’ebyo bye balaba.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Enkula y’okulaba wakati wa wiiki bbiri n’omwezi gumu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Mu myezi esatu amaaso gaabwe bulijjo galina okuba nga gagoloddwa era nga gakolagana okukola okulaba kwa 3D. Endowooza eno empya ey’obuziba ebayamba okutuuka ku bintu mu butuufu. Bajja kusobola okugoberera ebintu ebitambula amangu naye nga kizibu okukyusa fixation okuva ku face emu oba object okudda ku ndala mu bwangu.
Baagala nnyo okutunuulira ekintu kimu kyokka omulundi gumu. Era bayinza okutandika okukola amaloboozi gaabwe agasooka ag’amakulu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Enkula y’okulaba wakati w’omwezi gumu n’esatu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Omwana omuwere alina okulaba okukulaakulana okwa bulijjo ajja kucamuka ng’alaba ekikopo oba ekijiiko ky’okunywa era bulijjo asobola okutereeza n’okugoberera ffeesi eri mu bbanga lya mita 1-2 nga kw’otadde n’okusobola okwawula ffeesi z’amanyi n’ez’atamanyi ku maaso ge n’amaloboozi ge.
Era basobola okutandika okulaba ebintu ebiri ewala. Nga bavugibwa okwagala okumanya, bajja kutandika okutuuka ku bintu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: Ku myezi 6 ku 12 obukali bw’okulaba egenda etereera era eri ku 6/36. Ebanga ffeesi kwe zitunuulirwa n’okumanyibwa liweze okutuuka ku mita 2. Ebintu byonna eby’okulaba bigenda bitereera nga bituuse bulungi n’okukwata.

Ku myaka gino beeyongera okwagala ebifaananyi mu bitabo ne ku ttivvi, wadde ng’ebintu ebituufu biba bisikiriza nnyo nga bibakubiriza okwekulukuunya n’okwetooloola amazaalibwa gaabwe agasooka, okutambula nga boolekedde ebintu bye baagala. Enjogera yaabwe egenda ekula, era amaloboozi gajja kufuuka ebigambo ebisooka ku myaka gino nagyo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Ku myezi 18, okulaba kuba kwa muntu mukulu nnyo nga wadde nga kukyali kuzibuwalira katono ku obukali bw’okulaba of around 6/18. Kati bajja kusobola okutegeera erinnya lyabwe era nga beeyongera okukozesa ebigambo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Enkula y’okulaba wakati w’emyezi kkumi n’ebiri n’ekkumi n’omunaana
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi 18 okulaba kwetaaga emyaka egiwerako okukula. obukali bw’okulaba omuntu omukulu eya bulijjo ejja kutondebwawo nga wa myaka 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Enkula y’okulaba wakati w’emyezi kkumi na munaana n’emyaka munaana
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka 8 enkola y’okulaba eyinza obutatereera bulungi ku bujjanjabi ng’okulongoosa amaaso. Okuzuula obulwadde n’okusindikibwa okujjanjabibwa n’olwekyo kirungi okukolebwa nga bukyali mu bulamu nga bwe kisoboka.

Kiyinza okulabibwa nti enkula nnyingi nnyo ebaawo wakati w’okuzaalibwa n’emyezi 18 era egenda mu maaso mpola mu buto bwonna obusigadde. Mu kiseera kino kyetaagisa omwana okuba omulamu obulungi ng’alina enkola y’okulaba etaliimu bulwadde era ng’aweebwa embeera esitula n’okusomesa ebiriisa.
Okuzuula amangu obulwadde nga osindikiddwa okujjanjabibwa kikulu okuyamba okutumbula enkula y’okulaba n’okukula okwa bulijjo.

questions.prompt: Okulaba kw’omulwadde kuwandiikiddwa nga 6/60 mu liiso lye erya ddyo. Ebanga ki eryali lisinga okubeera wakati w’omulwadde n’ekipande ng’okulaba kwabwe kwakeberebwa?
questions.explanation: Snellen acuity ewandiikibwa nga ebanga egezeseddwa / layini etunuuliddwa. N’olwekyo, 6/60 kitegeeza nti omulwadde yakeberebwa ku mmita 6 okuva ku kipande era n’alaba layini 60, mu ngeri entuufu ennukuta esinga obunene waggulu ku kipande.

questions.prompt: Omulwadde yasangiddwa nga alina obukali bw’okulaba nga tayambiddwa ya 6/24 kyokka bwe yakeberebwa n’ekituli kya ppini yatereera okutuuka ku 6/9. Kiki ekisinga okuvaako kino?
questions.explanation: Singa obukali bw’okulaba etereera ng’otunudde mu kinnya kya ppini, ensonga esinga okulabika y’ensobi y’okuziyiza (refractive error) nga myopia. Emisinde emifunda egy’ekitangaala egy’enjawulo egiyingira mu liiso tegikosebwa nnyo bifo ebizimbulukuka, n’olwekyo giyita mu kitundu ekiyitibwa retina ekikyali mu kifo ekitunuulirwa.

questions.prompt: Omulwadde bwe yali akebera okulaba omulwadde yali tasobola kulaba nnukuta esinga obunene ku layini eya waggulu. Kiki ekiddako mu kugezesa okulaba kwabwe?
options: Gezaako okubala engalo oba entambula y’emikono
Saba omulwadde atunule mu kinnya kya ppini
questions.explanation: Omulwadde bw’aba tasobola kulaba nnukuta esinga obunene ku layini eya waggulu, kendeeza ku kitundu ky’obuwanvu bw’okukebera olabe oba kino kibasobozesa okulaba ennukuta yonna. Okugeza bwe baba tebasobola kulaba layini 60 ku mita 6, genda ku mita 3. Bwe baba nga olwo basobola okulaba layini ey’okungulu, wandiika obukali bw’okulaba nga 3/60.

questions.prompt: Omulwadde yasoma layini ‘6’ ku kipande ng’akebereddwa ku mmita 3. obukali bw’okulaba ki wansi esinga okuwandiika kino mu butuufu?
questions.explanation: Omulwadde ono alina obukali bw’okulaba ya 3/6 (distance tested / line seen). obukali bw’okulaba eyenkanankana yandibadde 6/12, nga guno gwe mugerageranyo gwe gumu era bwe kityo gwe gusinga obutuufu.

questions.prompt: obukali bw’okulaba y’omulwadde yawandiikibwa nga NPL mu liiso erya ddyo ne 6/6 mu liiso erya kkono. Kika ki eky’okulemererwa okulaba kye bandisobodde okutuukirira?
questions.explanation: Ebika by’okulemererwa okulaba byesigamiziddwa ku kulaba okw’amaaso abiri. Omuntu ne bw’aba ‘muzibe’ mu liiso erimu, bw’aba n’okulaba okwa bulijjo mu liiso eddala aba mu kibinja ky’abalina okulaba okwa bulijjo.

Waliwo engeri ssatu ez’okugezesa okuddamu kw’ekitangaala kya akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso: obutereevu, ng’olaba akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso ekitangaala kwe kyaka; mu ngeri etali butereevu oba nga bakkiriziganyizza, nga twetegereza munne akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso; n’okugezesa ekitangaala ekiwuubaala, nga twetegereza akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso ng’ekitangaala kituuka okunoonya RAPD.

options: Rapid Afferent akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso Ekikyamu
Relatively Affective akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso Ekikyamu

questions.explanation: RAPD egezesebwa nga ekozesa ekigezo ky’ekitangaala ekiwuubaala. Kino kireka omukebera okugeraageranya enkola z’okusikiriza ez’amaaso gombi ng’akebera eriiso erimu, ekifuula engeri ey’enjawulo ey’okuzuula oba enkola emu ey’okusikiriza eriko obuzibu bw’ogeraageranya n’endala.

questions.prompt: Kabonero ki ak’obujjanjabi akalabibwa mu RAPD?
options: Okuzimba obubi kwa akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso ng’ekitangaala kigiyaka
Okugaziwa kwa akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso nga ekitangaala kyaka ku yo
Tewali kuzibikira ng’ekitangaala kyaka ku kyo
Okugaziwa kwa akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso ng’ekitangaala kyaka ku liiso eddala
questions.explanation: akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso mu bujjuvu ejja kuzibikira ng’ekitangaala kigiyaka. Mu kiseera ky’okugezesa ekitangaala ekiwuubaala, okugaziwa okutali kwa njawulo ng’ekitangaala kituuse ku liiso kiraga nti RAPD eriwo ku ludda olwo.

questions.prompt: Bwe tukebera RAPD bitundu ki eby’ekkubo ly’okulaba bye twekenneenya?
options: Amakubo g’okulaba okuva mu bwongo obw’omu makkati okutuuka mu kitundu ky’omutwe ekiyitibwa occipital lobe
questions.explanation: Obusimu bw’amaaso (retina) n’obusimu bw’amaaso (optic nerve) bikola ebitundu eby’omu maaso eby’ensengekera y’ensengekera (afferent system), nga bitwala amawulire okuva mu liiso okutuuka mu bwongo obw’omu makkati okutandikawo enkola y’enkola y’omubiri (motor oba efferent response) ekyusa obunene bwa akatuli akaddugavu ak’eriiso.
Obulwadde bwonna obw’amaaso oba obusimu bw’amaaso obukosa enkola yaayo ey’okusikiriza buyinza okuvaako RAPD, omuli n’ekintu ekibaawo mu misuwa ekikosa retina.

questions.prompt: Ku bino wammanga kigendererwa ki ekikulu eky’okukebera ‘fundal ‘red’ reflex test mu mwana eyaakazaalibwa?
questions.explanation: Mu mwana omuwere, ekigendererwa ekikulu kwe kuzuula obulwadde obuziyiza ekitangaala okuyingira mu liiso. Kino kiyinza okuzingiramu obulwadde bw’amaaso, lenzi, vitreous, retina oba optic nerve.

questions.prompt: Omwana omuwere ow’emyezi 3 alina ekifaananyi ekitangalijja ekya ‘red’ reflex mu liiso erya kkono naye nga mu liiso erya ddyo alina ekizibu ekizibu ennyo. Kiki ekisinga okutuukirawo?
options: Tegeka okusindikibwa mu bwangu eri omusawo omukugu mu maaso
Tegeka okusindikibwa bulijjo eri omusawo omukugu mu maaso
questions.explanation: Obutali bwa bulijjo bwonna ku kukeberebwa kuno bwetaagisa okwekenneenya amangu omukugu mu maaso kubanga obulwadde obw’amaanyi, gamba ng’okuzimba amaaso oba retinoblastoma, buyinza okubaawo.

questions.prompt: Omwana ow’emyezi 9 azaalibwa ku wiiki 36 ng’ali lubuto yeeyoleka ng’alaba bulungi era nga taliiwo bikozesebwa mu maaso mu maaso gombi. Kiki ekisinga okuvaako ebizuuliddwa bino?
questions.explanation: Okufiirwa ekitangaala ekimyufu ekidda okuva munda mu liiso kiva ku kintu ekiziyiza ekitangaala okuyingira mu liiso. Retinopathy of Prematurity esobola okuvaako retina okuvaamu, naye esinga kubeera mu baana abazaalibwa nga tebannaweza wiiki 34. Obulwadde bwa Retinoblastoma busobola okuvaako okufiirwa ekitundu ky’omubiri ekiyitibwa reflex naye nga tatera kubaawo, nga bubaawo mu baana nga 1 ku buli 15,000 abazaalibwa. Obulwadde bw’amaaso bwe businga okuvaako abaana abawere n’abaana abawere, nga buli baana 1,000 okutuuka ku 2,000 bubaawo.

questions.prompt: Ku mbeera zino wammanga mu muntu omukulu, kiruwa ekitatera kuleeta ‘abnormal fundal ‘red’ reflex?
options: Okuvaamu omusaayi mu bitundu by’omubiri ebiyitibwa Vitreous Haemorrhage
questions.explanation: Occipital lobe stroke tekitera kubaawo. Wadde nga kireeta okubulwa okulaba, kino kiva ku kwonooneka kw’obwongo okusinga endwadde ezikosa okutegeera kw’emikutu gy’amaaso.

questions.prompt: Bizimbe ki, era mu nsengeka ki, ekitangaala kiyitamu okumulisiza fundus ne kivaamu fundal ‘red’ reflex?
questions.explanation: Ekitangaala kiyita mu cornea, lens ne vitreous okutuuka mu retina, oluwuzi olutangaavu olubikka ku choroid ya fundus ekitangaala mwe kiva. Obulwadde bw’amaaso, lenzi, vitreous, retina oba choroid n’olwekyo busobola okuleeta okukeberebwa kwa ekitangaala ekimyufu ekidda okuva munda mu liiso okutali kwa bulijjo.

Bw’oba okola akawunti, nsaba okuume ebikwata ku kuyingira kwo nga bikuumibwa.
Ovunaanyizibwa ku bikolebwa ku akawunti yo okuggyako ng’otutegeezezza ku nkozesa embi oba ekizibu ky’obukuumi.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: App eno kye kimu ku bikozesebwa mu kusomesa okuwagira okuyiga n’okuddamu okutunula. Si magezi mu butongole mu by’ensoma, mu mateeka oba ag’ekikugu era tegayinza kukakasa kuyita bigezo, bubonero oba ebivaamu byonna ebitongole. Okulonda n’okusalawo mu kusoma bisigala nga buvunaanyizibwa bw’omukozesa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Data eno eyamba okutuukanya app okusinziira ku biruubirirwa bya buli muntu, okutegeera engeri app gy’ekozesebwamu n’okulongoosa ebikozesebwa mu bbanga. Era kiyinza okukozesebwa okukwatagana ku nkyukakyuka enkulu ku app oba akawunti.
Personal data is never sold.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Endagamuntu eyinza okwetaaga okukakasibwa nga okusaba tekunnaggwa. Singa amawulire gonna galina okukuumibwa olw’ensonga z’amateeka oba ez’ebyokwerinda, kino kijja kunnyonnyolwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Amawulire gokka ageetaagisa okuddukanya n’okulongoosa empeereza eno ge gakung’aanyizibwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Ekigendererwa kwe kukuuma app nga eyamba era nga yeesigika, naye tewali mpeereza etuukiridde. Okubeerawo obutasalako oba eddembe mu bujjuvu okuva mu nsobi tekiyinza kusuubizibwa, era app eyinza obutakwatagana na buli mbeera.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Amawulire gaterekebwa ku seva eddukanyizibwa ne database ewereddwa Railway. Oluguudo lw’eggaali y’omukka lwe luwa ekifo eky’okukyaza n’ebikozesebwa; tufuga engeri data gy’ekozesebwamu munda mu app era tugikuuma okumala ebbanga lyokka nga bwe kyetaagisa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Twesigamye ku mpeereza ez’abantu ab’okusatu ezesigika, gamba ng’abagaba okukyaza, okuddukanya app. Empeereza zino zikola data yokka nga bwe kyetaagisa okusobola okuwa ebikozesebwa era tezirina lukusa kuzikozesa ku bigendererwa byabwe.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Okusinziira ku mateeka ga Bungereza, tetuvunaanyizibwa ku kufiirwa ng’obubonero obusubiddwa, ssente ezifiiriddwa oba emikisa egiva mu kukozesa, oba obutasobola kukozesa, app. Tewali kintu kyonna wano kiggyawo ddembe lyonna eriweebwa mu mateeka ga Bungereza.

usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_001: Akatambi kano kalaga endabika ya fundal ekitangaala ekimyufu ekidda okuva munda mu liiso eya bulijjo n’etali ya bulijjo.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_002: Okukebera okwa bulijjo okwa wansi ekitangaala ekimyufu ekidda okuva munda mu liiso kwe kuba nga tewali njawulo okutwalira awamu mu kumasamasa ne langi wakati w’amaaso gombi nga galina ebifaananyi by’amaaso ag’omu makkati.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_003: Kyokka n’endabika eya bulijjo eya ekitangaala ekimyufu ekidda okuva munda mu liiso ejja kwawukana okusinziira ku bbanga ly’oli ne omwana gy’atunudde.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_004: Kiba kigezo kya maanyi (active dynamic examination) nga olina okutambula okuva ku ludda olumu okudda ku lulala n’okudda emabega munda n’okwetooloola obuwanvu bw’omukono okuva ku mulwadde.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_005: Abalongo n’abaana nabo bajja kutambuza emikono n’amaaso gaabwe, ekifuula reflex okukyusa engeri gye yeefaananyirizaamu nga bakeberebwa.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_006: Mu mwana omuddugavu, ekiwujjo kitera okulabika nga kiddugavu nnyo, nga langi ya kyenvu n’enjeru ate oluusi ne bbululu ye langi enkulu.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_007: Ekikulu, mu kukebera okwa bulijjo, tewalina kubaawo njawulo okutwalira awamu mu kumasamasa ne langi wakati w’amaaso gombi nga galina ebifaananyi by’amaaso ag’omu makkati.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_008: Ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo (abnormal reflex) bwe wabaawo enjawulo etaggwaawo, eya nnamaddala mu kumasamasa ne langi wakati w’amaaso gombi.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_009: Okutunula kw’amaaso okusengulwa, ekitundu ekiddugavu ekibeera munda mu kifaananyi ky’eriiso erimu oba amaaso gombi, oba ekitangaala ekimyufu ekidda okuva munda mu liiso etaliiwo ddala.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_010: Okukebera reflex etali ya bulijjo kuyinza okulaga nti waliwo cataract, retinoblastoma, enkovu y’amaaso, okuzimba amaaso, ensobi mu refractive error oba obuzibu obuzaalibwa nabwo nga coloboma.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_011: Bino byonna byetaaga okwongera okwekenneenya omukugu.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_012: Laba reflex eno era weebuuze: kino kya bulijjo oba si kya bulijjo? Eby’okuddamu bijja kugoberera oluvannyuma.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_013: Kati olina okutegeera obulungi engeri reflex eyabulijjo gy’efaanana, awamu n’ensengekera ezitali za bulijjo, era ng’osobola okuteesa ku kisinga okuvaako.
